title: Construct the normalized native common-field functor
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a Noetherian scheme of finite Krull dimension, with $\ell$ a unit in every local ring. There exists a normalized native functor of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-normalized-functor]. In particular, construct the coefficient presentations, exact section transport, additive triangulated functor, integral natural comparisons and canonical common-field normalization. No full-faithfulness, essential-image or smallness clause is concluded.

source.place: Native realization proof steps 2--5, with the geometric hypotheses provided explicitly.

proof.text: Construct C using [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-coefficient-system] and obtain its normalized finite cocone A from [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-finite-cocone]. These are separate coefficient and finite-stage assertions, neither of which supplies the required global pair functor.

Define J by the existing StageSystem.descFunctor/ofCocone construction. In a common stage, J sends a representative u to the inverse cocone leg, then Phi(u), then the target cocone leg. Cocone coherence makes this independent of representatives and preserves composition. The existing additive common-stage coordinates of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] reduce additivity to Phi(u+v)=Phi(u)+Phi(v).

Use the proved library pairCommShift and pairShiftIso formulas for the given, already normalized source shift, followed by evaluation of the constant target stage system. Cancel the inclusion shift isomorphism with its inverse to prove that each restriction isomorphism commutes with shifts. Every distinguished triangle is isomorphic to a finite-stage triangle by [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]; the finite triangulated functor then proves J triangulated.

Take the components of A.integral as the global integral comparison. Its naturality follows by evaluating descFunctor on stage-inclusion arrows, where it is exactly the finite functor. Evaluate J on the actual isoToStage arrow: the proved pairFunctor_transIso formula makes its image exactly the inverse cocone leg. Substitute in A.normalization and cancel the identity components of the restriction isomorphisms. This gives the literal common_field HEq required by the unchanged NormalizedFunctor statement.

proof_origin.place: E7: explicit coherent-cocone descent, additive common-stage coordinates, normalized shifts, finite-stage triangle representation and evaluation of the actual isoToStage transition; coefficient and finite cocone steps are split off separately.
